verdict.rationale: Yapily provides the event side of automation: real-time webhooks for platform changes and payment status, with subscriptions to multiple event categories. Any rule logic or triggered action has to live on the customer's own HTTPS endpoint. Scheduled and recurring payments and VRP are time-based instructions, not event-triggered rules. Missing for 10: a native rule/automation engine, configurable conditions, built-in action triggers on events, and independent corroboration.
